items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where Sonny Cohn come out of.

ctx.x: What were some of the local bands around here that had a big impact on you? You mentioned Jimmie Lunceford, Duke Ellington, Count Basie, and all those bands. But what were the local ones?
There was only – really, the only three I can think about was King Fleming’s big band, which I was in for a while. That’s where Sonny Cohn come out of. You know of Sonny Cohn, don’t you?
